brief: CRITIC round 3 for wave-1 piece W1-14 (magic, seam S19). Prior: 2.7 (r1), 4.4 (r2).
outputs_written: corpus/90-verdicts/wave1/W1-14-r3.json (schema-valid, 4 warnings, three answered in native_score_note prose)
findings: TREE DOES NOT BOOT at HEAD or in the working tree, for TWO reasons both owned by other pieces: (a) game/data/input/profiles.json (new in commit 12be950) violates its own RI-JRN04 H11 assertion twice - heavy/parry 6.9 px and block/roll 0.11 px against an 8 px minimum, so TouchInput._assertLayout throws on every boot; (b) a concurrent session is mid-build on game/data/quests/mainline-act1..4 and index.json/hooks.json, giving QuestBook/QuestEngine integrity throws that changed 4 times in 20 minutes. smoke.mjs PASSES throughout because it never boots the engine.

WORKAROUND (declared as a method deviation): all measurement is taken against a PINNED MIRROR of the working tree at scratchpad/pin/game, with exactly two edits, neither in game/src and neither touching magic: touch button radii set to 22 (satisfies H11), and the in-flight mainline-act quest files removed from data/index.json. api-probe 33/33 against the mirror.

M8 / ARENA AUDIT, THE HEADLINE: the builder's census arena replaced setMagicSkills({...100}) with 700 iterations of {4 x grantSkillUse('cast_effective',{cost:40})} + hearthRest(). MEASURED what that loop leaves behind: sorcery 100, root-speech 99, warding 100, veiling 100. It is setMagicSkills({...100}) with extra steps. RI-MAG06 E/M8 requires the census be RE-RUN WITHOUT the gating call and the delta reported; that was never done for this loop.
Default shipped sheet in default/arena_flat/dungeon_primary: sorcery 5, root-speech 10, warding 5, veiling 5, focus_max 94. sap-reader chosen at creation: 25/5/25/15, focus_max 56.

h_fortify_skill (apply.js:216) computes `which = rec.school || 'warding'` and NEVER USES IT: the loop fortifies ALL FOUR schools plus stealth security AND sneak. One fortify_skill cast raises every magic school at once.

53/55 SURVIVES MY OWN INSTRUMENT. critic-w1-14-r3-census.mjs (written from RI-MAG06 D, never running the builder's) at the builder's arena skill level: DISTINCT-VERBS all-paths 53/55, world-side 43/55, moved_anything 55/55, not_delivered 0, exactly two collision groups [bind_lesser,bind_greater] and [calm_beast,demoralise]. Null-vs-null control drift 0 paths in both an empty and an aggroed room; ZERO effects had an unstable path across the repeat run, so the number is not noise-inflated.

M8 DELTA, WHICH THE BUILDER NEVER RAN: the same census at practice=0 (a sap-reader straight out of creation, sorcery 25 / root-speech 5 / warding 25 / veiling 15) gives DISTINCT-VERBS 30/55 all-paths, 25/55 world-side, and 25 of 55 effects NOT CASTABLE AT ALL - every one refused at attunement for skill.

LADDER IS CLIMBABLE (Q5 answered). Real casts only, no grantSkillUse: sorcery 25->45 in 169 casts, ->65 in 365, ->100 in 673 (20.6 min of sim time in the casts alone); veiling 15->45 in 142, ->100 in 689; warding 25->45 in 349, ->65 in 783; root-speech 5->45 in 729. So 17/72 is a gate, not a wall - the skill-100 census is a state a player can reach. fortify_skill CANNOT be used to jump the gate: its min_tier forces tier 3 / skill_req 45, so a starting character cannot attune it.

CAMERA OVERRIDE IS NOT BROKEN. H.camera({pos,look,fov}) is honoured by the model AND by the renderer: readback exact, survives 24 steps and a full cast, and the pixels change 96.94% (builder's own pose vs the default rig), 96.08% (far/high/fov20), 99.999% (looking the other way). loadState clears it, which is correct. The builder's blocked item rests on a bug that does not exist.

AP-M3 INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED. Turn rate re-derived by me from consecutive heading_deg, fence recomputed as 0.35 x the flight the bolt ACTUALLY had: LIGHT 60 dps before / 0 after / 0 violating frames, HEAVY 45 / 0 / 0, CANTRIP 0 (null control). --break=nocutoff goes red at 72 and 106 violating frames. Against a STATIONARY target every class reads 0 dps even before the fence - the protocol's own point, reproduced.

NEW DEFECT, FOUND BY MOVING THE TARGET: a spell cannot hit anything that moves. LIGHT bolt at 18 m against a target strafing at 0 m/s -> 80 damage; at 1.5 m/s -> 0; 3 m/s -> 0; 5 m/s -> 0; 7 m/s -> 0. spell_impact fires every time, effect_apply only at 0 m/s. The tracking that AP-M3 proves is fenced is also tracking that never closes on a moving body.

FRENZY IS DEAD WORLD-SIDE. effect_apply fires, b.frenzyTarget is set to the other body, and after 900 frames both enemies are at 412 hp - byte-identical to the no-cast control. grep: frenzyTarget and ctl.hostileTo are written only by apply.js h_frenzy and read by nothing in the AI.

DETECT_LIFE / DETECT_KEY move NOTHING world-side. Their entire census signature is m:world.markers.* - magic's own array. HUD marker count 0 before and after (S8-compliant) and getUIState() byte-identical. Nothing in game/src/render reads M.markers, so the effect is invisible to the player.

SAP_WARD's DISPOSITION CONSUMER IS A DEAD READ. dialogue/disposition.js:167 reads `player.sapTaintBand`; grep over all of game/src shows NOTHING writes that field. Measured at taint band 4 in helstrom-market: all four NPCs' disposition explain-terms are {race, upbringing} only, with no sap_taint term, and the numbers are identical to band 0.

OPEN_LOCK / SHATTER's 'world-side durable register' has no consumer. sim.world.doorsUnlocked and shortcutsOpened are written only by sim/magic/apply.js and read only by harness/api.js and save/state.js. No door, traversal or quest gate in game/src consults either.

game/data/magic/wards.json ships its own _placement_note: 'Coordinates are inside arena_flat, within the reach declared in WORLD_REACH_M of a spell cast forward from the origin.' The locks, traps, breakables, keys and shrines the utility verbs act on exist only as a fixture placed for the probe; there is not one lock in helstrom-market, stormhold-street or any populated state.

TELEKINESIS IS REAL - I was wrong on the first pass. Through the actual `interact` press (engine.js:1500 gates on the prop's own reach_m): a censer at 5.0 m is NOT taken without the spell and IS taken with it (reach 2.2 -> 27.75, inventory 1 -> 2). My first pass used takeProp(), which is a harness surface that does not check reach at all - a harness-integrity note for W1-00, not a magic defect.

open_lock / lock_lock / ward_trap / shatter all DELIVER when cast from inside WORLD_REACH_M and write both the magic register and the quest-flag register: 5 locks opened, 3 traps disarmed, 2 shortcuts opened, flags lock:*:open / trap:*:disarmed / shatter:* raised.

CALM_BEAST, DEMORALISE and CHARM ARE ONE VERB, not two. All three: delivered, yielded true, in_combat false, and displacement 0.00 m over 720 frames. Demoralise does not make the target flee - it yields in place, identical to calm. The builder admitted a 2-way collision; it is 3-way.

BIND: bind_lesser summons INFANTRY hp 260 at magnitude 1 AND at 90 (magnitude-blind); bind_greater summons hp 640 at magnitude 1 and is REFUSED at 90. So they are not 'the identical thing' - the hp differs - but both are magnitude-blind and share a signature.

REGRESSION - ENEMY CASTERS STILL DO NOT EXIST. cst_sap_speaker aggroed for 1200 frames: one distinct state (REPOSITION/e_idle), zero cast events, zero player damage. Identical to the round-1 finding. RI-MAG01 F and its six anti-patterns AP-M1/M2/M4/M5/M6 have never been measurable on any build, and neither round 2 nor round 3 touched it.

SUSPECTED REGRESSION - LEVITATION ALTITUDE 0. setLevitating(true) + 240 frames spends 36 Focus and gains 0.000 m of pos[1]; round 2 measured 5.5867 m at 1.5 Focus/m and passed RI-MAG02 M4.1 on it. Being re-measured from three surfaces in final.mjs before it is charged.

SUSPECTED REGRESSION - S29's 300-frame hostile cooldown. Recall cast 110 frames after damagePlayer() moved 84.926 m, the same distance as the quiet case and the same as with the fence deliberately broken. Being re-measured across 0/30/60/120/240/299/360/600 frames in final.mjs.

VFX: the camera works, so the frames are judgeable. With a framing I chose (contact at 45 deg FOV from 3.2 m) the impact peak changes 15.36% of a 1920x1080 frame against a same-pose control, impact_f0 10.76%, release 2.47%, residue still 2.08% at 20 s. The builder's 0.083% was a framing artefact, not the art.

RI-MAG05 A-M1 FAILS BADLY. Sampled per the item's own method (release frame, top 2% luminance of effect-only pixels): core renders #FFFFFF and mid #FFF6A9, against a declared sorcery_marshfire core #F0B24E / mid #C86A2A. deltaE76 64.0 (core) and 59.3 (mid) against a bar of <= 12. The authored palette is in vfx.json and does not survive the additive HDR core plus ACES tonemap. A-M3 chroma budget passes at 0.59% (bar 8%) largely BECAUSE the effect is white.

AT NIGHT THE SPELL LIGHTS NOTHING. A fire burst 1 m off the ground at setTimeOfDay(1) leaves the ground black and the pillars as flat silhouettes: no pool of light, no bounce. V4 as RI-MAG05 defines it (particles RECEIVE scene light) is satisfied; a spell that is a light source is not.

CORRECTED, IMPORTANT: LEVITATION IS FINE. With a `jump` press it climbs 0.400 m per 30 frames while Focus falls 0.60 per 30 frames = exactly 1.5 Focus/m, identical through H.setLevitating and through a commissioned LIGHT levitate spell. My earlier 0 m reading was my own probe never pressing jump. Round 2's pass holds.

S29's 300-FRAME COOLDOWN IS UNDEMONSTRABLE IN EITHER DIRECTION. sim.lastHostileFrame is stamped only from bus HOSTILE_EVENTS in sim/step.js:45; H.damagePlayer() emits none of them, so the builder's evidence for the clause was measuring inCombat. I could not arm it either, because an aggroed enemy at 1.3 m leaves the player on full health for 600-900 frames in this build. Recorded unmeasured, not broken, and filed as an arbitration question.

RI-MAG04 M6: casting open_lock + shatter + ward_trap across all 28 Q-MAG quests moves available resolutions 26 -> 27. Exactly ONE magic route opens (Q-MAG-01/mag_the_warded_ledger__magic). Zero quest events, journal 0->0, and questOpen('Q-MAG-01') still refuses on an entry topic. hooks.json's eleven flag->journal mappings all fire the flag and consume nothing.

RI-MAG05 ART = 0 BY THE ITEM'S OWN 0-BAND. Section A2 names `pure #FFFFFF core` and `additive-white bloom with no hue at all` among the six forbidden anchors; the measured release-frame core is #FFFFFF, separation 0.00. FIDELITY is 6 (9/10 features, V1/V2/V4 present, M8 delta passes - FS_score 0.0145 -> 0.0180, i.e. the spell DE-flattens the frame). min(ART,FID) = 0.

VERDICT: FAIL 4.6/10 vs a 7.0 gate. RI-MAG01 5, RI-MAG02 6, RI-MAG03 6, RI-MAG04 4, RI-MAG05 0, RI-MAG06 6, RI-PRG03 6, RI-QST05 4. AR-1 pass, AR-2 pass, AR-3 not sterile (one demonstrated crossing), CONSUMPTION partial (4 models with no consumer).

BIGGEST GAP: GAP-W1-magic-cannot-hit-a-moving-target (magic.casting.geometry). LIGHT bolt at 18 m: 80 damage against a still body, 0 at 1.5/3/5/7 m/s. spell_impact fires every time, effect_apply only at 0 m/s.
notes_for_successor:
TWO REPO-WIDE BLOCKERS TO ESCALATE, neither W1-14's:
1. game/data/input/profiles.json (new at commit 12be950) violates its own RI-JRN04 H11 assertion twice - heavy/parry 6.9 px, block/roll 0.11 px against an 8 px minimum - so TouchInput._assertLayout throws before window.__HARNESS appears. EVERY probe in the project that boots the engine is blocked. smoke.mjs passes anyway because it never boots the engine; that is worth fixing on its own.
2. The mainline-act quest files, index.json and hooks.json were mutually inconsistent for the whole of this run.

I measured against a pinned mirror at scratchpad/pin/game with only those two things patched. Recreate it with:
  cp -a game <SCRATCH>/pin/game ; set every touch button r to 22 in data/input/profiles.json ; drop the mainline-act entries from data/index.json
then pass --entry <SCRATCH>/pin/game/index.html to any probe.

FOR THE NEXT BUILDER, in value order: (1) the projectile does not re-acquire a moving target - fix sim/magic/system.js's projectile step and re-run tools/harness/critic-w1-14-r3-motion.mjs; (2) clamp the VFX core's emissive so the authored palette survives the ACES tonemap - it renders #FFFFFF, the exact forbidden anchor; (3) enemy casters do not exist on ANY of ten archetypes and have not for three rounds; (4) detect_life, detect_key and frenzy write registers nothing reads, and player.sapTaintBand is read by dialogue and written by nobody; (5) calm_beast/demoralise/charm are one verb (0.00 m displacement on all three).

FOR THE NEXT CRITIC: my census (tools/harness/critic-w1-14-r3-census.mjs) takes --practice N and reports three signatures plus a repeat-stability filter and an empty-empty control. Run it at --practice 0 AND at whatever the ladder says is reachable; publishing only one number is how this metric gets gamed.
